taskDesc106001.ch: 为宗门扩张一格领地，扩张的领地需要紧邻当前领地，并且距离宗门不能超过宗门的最大领地范围。扩张领地会受到格子内的怪物的强烈抵抗，副本难度较大。

taskDesc107001.en: Find a Cultivator of the same or a higher Realm that's from an enemy sect. Defeat this Cultivator to increase your sect's Prestige.
taskDesc107001.ch: 寻找一名境界不低于自身的敌道弟子，并将其击败，以证本宗之威，提升宗门的名誉。

taskDesc108001.en: A Mythical Beast has appeared near your sect. Kill the Mythical Beast to prevent it from hurting innocent people.
taskDesc108001.ch: 近日在宗门附近出现了一只大妖兽，消灭此妖兽，避免其伤害到附近的百姓。

taskDesc108002.en: A rebellious monster has appeared near your sect. Kill the monster to prevent it from hurting your sect members.
taskDesc108002.ch: 在宗门附近出现了叛乱的妖兽，消灭此妖兽，避免其伤害附近的同门。

taskDesc110018.en: The mysterious man asks for your help in killing a person. He has yet to tell you who it is that needs to be killed, and even he himself does not know where that person is...
taskDesc110018.ch: 神秘男子让你帮忙击杀一个人，但他既未告诉你击杀何人，他自己也不知道对方所在何处…

taskDesc110019.en: Find Ask Thy Heart and give it to Yuanzhi

taskDesc110020.en: Give Ask Thy Heart to Yuanzhi。

taskDesc110021.ch: 在宗门的{#schoolBuildingName1102}化灵获得任意一种灵果

taskDesc110031.en: Follow Jo's words, go near the mentioned location, and use geomancy to locate the Mirage Qi Orb that can help you survive the Transcendent Trial.
taskDesc110031.ch: 按照李四的话语，前往指定区域进行堪舆，寻找能使你在登仙天劫中存活下来的蜃灵珠。

taskDesc110032.en: Follow Jo's words, and use geomancy in places brimmed with Qi to locate the site to endure the trial and break through to Transcendent Realm! (You could try to find it in locations with dense Qi)
taskDesc110032.ch: 按照李四的话语，在八荒中寻找灵气旺盛之地使用堪舆找到最终面对天劫、突破登仙的地方！（可寻找各灵气旺盛之处尝试）

taskDesc110033.en: Follow Jo's words, go near the mentioned location, and use geomancy to locate the Mirage Qi Orb that can help you survive the Transcendent Trial.
taskDesc110033.ch: 按照李四的话语，前往指定区域进行堪舆，寻找能使你在登仙天劫中存活下来的蜃灵珠。

taskDesc110034.en: A beautiful mortal girl wants to be a cultivator, but she can't get any Spirit Stones. Give some to her.
taskDesc110034.ch: 一位美丽的凡人姑娘想走上修仙之路，但奈何寻不到灵石。送她一些灵石。

taskDesc1101003.en: Find {item}, then go to Taihang Mountains and deliver it to Jagu.
taskDesc1101003.ch: 寻找{item}，并将其送到太行山中给武罗。

taskDesc1101004.en: Acquire Frost Lead at the Yun Mo Auction and deliver it to Shuang Ling.
taskDesc1101004.ch: 前往云陌州拍卖会取得冰铅转交给霜凌。

taskDesc1108116.en: Go to {dungeonID}. Kill {dungeonBoss} to get its Soul Orb.
